pages.title: Crunchy Bumpkin
pages.text: Crunchy Bumpkin is one of only three Skitchin' songs with an FM lead playing over the band. The other two are Loser and the Title Screen music. Crunchy Bumpkin plays in Los Angeles, the sixth race, a 4.8-mile course whose password is STARS.

pages.title: The inline skating boom
pages.text: In the early '90s, inline skates were a craze. US sales grew from $22 million in 1989 to over $70 million in 1990. Emergency rooms treated 37,000 skaters in 1993 and expected 83,000 in 1994.

pages.title: Why FIFA Soccer sounds techno
pages.text: Programmer Brian Plank, who is also in Skitchin's credits, is the reason FIFA Soccer has a techno soundtrack. The producer wanted the brass you hear on TV sports shows, but Brian told composer Jeff van Dyck to follow his own instincts instead.
